cassia.predicted_cell_type: Fibroblast / mesenchymal / stromal cell with possible mixed-lineage contamination
strengths: Correctly identifies the dominant fibroblast/ECM program (DCN, KERA, OGN, COL1A1, PDGFRL, FBLN1, MMP2)
Flags out-of-lineage markers (PNOC, MYH6, CDX1, SLC6A19) instead of forcing an overly clean label
weaknesses: Label is not a single clean cell type and mapping is unresolved (mixed_signal)
Overstates possible mixed-lineage without proportion or doublet evidence
Ciliated-cell inference relies on weak/indirect markers (CEP97, FAAP20)

strengths: Recognizes the mesenchymal/stromal character of the cluster
Consistent with ECM-related markers such as DCN, OGN, COL1A1, ACTA2
weaknesses: Less specific than fibroblast; canonical fibroblast markers (DCN, KERA, OGN, COL1A1, PDGFRL, FBLN1) meaningfully favor the fibroblast branch
CL:0008019 and CL:0000057 are non-hierarchical in the frozen ontology, so the more specific fibroblast branch is preferred
Ignores the potential contamination signals highlighted by the marker list

strengths: Directly supported by canonical fibroblast markers DCN, KERA, OGN, COL1A1, PDGFRL, FBLN1, MMP2
Consistent with keratan sulfate/glycosaminoglycan metabolism enrichment and DCN/COL1A1/OGN hub genes
Produces a clean, ontology-valid single primary label
weaknesses: Incorrectly states that no epithelial markers are present despite CDX1, SLC6A19, TRPV6
Dismisses MYH6/TBX20/TNNI3K as spurious without direct evidence
Does not address possible ambient contamination

supporting: Fibroblast branch supported by canonical markers DCN, KERA, OGN, COL1A1, PDGFRL, FBLN1, FNDC1, CCN5, SFRP4, MMP2
Reactome keratan sulfate/glycosaminoglycan metabolism terms are consistent with fibroblast/ECM identity
Protein interaction hubs DCN, ACTA2, MMP2, COL1A1, OGN support a fibroblast/matrix-producing phenotype
conflicting: PNOC, IL17REL, GFRA2 suggest possible neuroendocrine/tuft-like signal
MYH6, TBX20, TNNI3K suggest myocardial/contamination signal
SLC6A19, CDX1, TRPV6 suggest intestinal/renal-type epithelial contamination
DNAAF1, CEP97, FAAP20 suggest ciliated cell contamination
enrichment_or_literature: Reactome: Diseases associated with glycosaminoglycan metabolism
